in_short: The register page is kept out of search on purpose. That is right, and nothing changed for ranking or in the text.
This is the page where an owner opens an account, and nothing about it was counted. You could not see how many owners registered, how many failed, or which campaign brought them.
7 changes are on the branch: 3 technical, 4 tracking.

scorecard.before: Yes: noindex, not in the sitemap

scorecard.after: Same tag and consent settings as the homepage

scorecard.metric: Layout shift while loading, lab test

needs_you_intro: Two things about this page are decisions for you. I changed neither.

needs_you.title: An account is created without a word about the terms
needs_you.detail: The form takes a restaurant name, an email address and a password and creates an account. It does not point to the Terms of Use or the Privacy Policy, except through the footer. Most sign-up forms carry a line such as "By creating an account you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy". That sentence binds the owner, so it has to be your decision.
needs_you.action: Tell me whether you want the line, and whether it should be a plain pointer or an agreement.

needs_you.title: The confirmation email lands wherever Supabase's Site URL points
needs_you.detail: This is the setting described in the login changelog. The success message here says "Check your email to confirm your account, then log in", so the natural landing page is the login page.
needs_you.action: In Supabase, Authentication, URL Configuration: set the Site URL to the login page. Or tell me to name the login page in the code, which works as soon as that address is on Supabase's list of allowed redirects.

needs_you.title: The same misleading message as on the login page
needs_you.detail: If the sign-in library fails to load, the page says "The Members Area is being set up. Registration opens once the project is connected." An owner with an ad blocker would take that to mean registration is closed.
needs_you.action: If you want, I change the wording for that case on all five Members Area pages at once.

changes_intro: Everything below is committed on `claude/practical-keller-adcqrc`. The page looks the same.

changes.title: Google Analytics added
changes.why: The tag is the homepage's, with the same consent defaults and the same stored choice. Like every page now, it sends the page address without anything that follows a #.
changes.after: gtag.js G-1235J90MCS, consent default denied, reads rihla_consent

changes.title: `sign_up` and `sign_up_failed`
changes.why: `sign_up` fires when Supabase accepts the registration. `sign_up_failed` fires when it rejects it, for example because the email is already registered. Neither carries the restaurant name, the email address or the password. `sign_up` is one of the event names GA4 recognizes without setup.
changes.after: gtag('event', 'sign_up', { method: 'password', first_source, first_medium, first_campaign })   ·   gtag('event', 'sign_up_failed')

changes.title: Each registration carries the campaign that first brought the owner
changes.why: `sign_up` includes `first_source`, `first_medium` and `first_campaign`, the same three values the homepage's lead events carry. If an owner first came through the owner email and registers a week later, the registration still points at that email. The helper that reads the saved campaign now lives in `site.js`.

changes.title: `cta_click` on 5 links, and the cookie notice
changes.why: `register_login` shows how many visitors already had an account. The cookie notice comes with `site.js`, which this page now loads.

changes.title: Icons and language, as on the homepage
changes.why: Added the `favicon.ico` fallback, the iPhone icon and `theme-color`, and set `lang="en-US"`.

changes.title: Same font request as the homepage
changes.why: The page now sends the identical request, so a visitor arriving from the homepage already has it cached.

changes.title: Taller tap areas
changes.why: "Back to Rihla" in the top bar was 18 px tall and the footer links 17 px. They are now 42 px and 29 px to tap. Nothing moved.

left_alone: **noindex, nofollow.** Correct, and the page is not in the sitemap.
**Title, description and text.** "Create your account." and "Free for 30 days, no card required" match the homepage and the terms.
**Share tags and structured data.** Left out on purpose on a page that should not be found or shared.
**The registration code.** Untouched apart from the Analytics lines. Where the confirmation link lands is unchanged.

In GA4, open Reports, then Realtime, after accepting cookies. A `sign_up` event should appear.
Delete the test account in Supabase afterwards.
